FxtDocumentDescription.p: Export to a standalone LaTeX document using the gb4e package's interlinear example macros (\ea / \gll / \glt / \z). Each phrase becomes one gb4e example with a morpheme line and a gloss line aligned word-by-word.

The file compiles on its own (\documentclass{article}, gb4e, utf8 inputenc, T1 fontenc), but the intent is that you copy the individual \ea ... \z blocks into an existing paper -- a leading comment in the file says so.
Requires the gb4e LaTeX package (available on CTAN and in most TeX distributions).
